artifact_role.en: Public README architecture view for the Audit / Plan / Operate runtime contract
artifact_role.zh_cn: 面向公开 README 的 Audit / Plan / Operate 运行契约架构图

audience.en: A repository owner or technical collaborator deciding whether this Skill fits a concrete re-entry, migration, consolidation, retirement, handoff, or evidence-led structural-change outcome. Also owners comparing accepted product intent with selected behavior.
audience.zh_cn: 正在为具体的重新进入、迁移、整合、退役、交接或证据驱动结构变更选择方法的仓库所有者与技术协作者。也包括对照已接受产品意图与所选行为的所有者。

primary_question.en: How does Repo Truth Audit turn an exact repository snapshot and a concrete owner intent into a bounded read-only answer, a decision-ready plan, or an authorized structural change or product convergence with verified completion without overclaiming evidence or external state?
primary_question.zh_cn: Repo Truth Audit 如何把精确仓库快照与明确所有者意图转化为有界只读答案、可执行计划，或经过验证完成的获授权结构变更或产品意图收敛，同时不夸大证据或外部状态？

answer_contract.en: Pin the engagement; reconstruct current operational truth and, when relevant, accepted product intent. Compare intent to behavior and behavior to purpose. Preserve the requested mode and verify the whole authorized outcome.
answer_contract.zh_cn: 钉住工作对象，重建运行事实及相关的已接受产品意图，双向追踪意图到行为、行为到用途，保留请求模式并验证完整获授权目标。

includes: One concrete owner intent and requested terminal boundary
One exact start and end repository snapshot
Repository-observable authority, selectors, callers, state, artifacts, and evidence gates
A read-only Plan result or explicitly authorized repository-local structural change or product convergence
Verified checkpoints, recovery reconciliation, and whole-goal acceptance
Explicitly authorized fresh external observation when it can change the decision
A bounded result and exact proof boundary
Scoped product-intent reconstruction, lifecycle resolution and bidirectional intent/behavior comparison
excludes: Mutation from Audit, Plan, or ambiguous cleanup language
A generic code review, quality score, compliance scan, or backlog
A full live-system or account audit without separate authorization
Universal rollback, exactly-once external effects, or a second orchestration engine
The packaging, installation, or release architecture of this Skill repository

layout_contract.theme_contract: Use Mermaid renderer defaults without hard-coded theme colors so GitHub can adapt the diagram to day or dark surfaces.
layout_contract.localization: Separate English and Simplified Chinese Mermaid blocks share region, node, semantic-edge, and connector-kind parity without mixing both languages in one diagram.

connector_legend.zh_cn: 范围内的证据或实现流程

connector_legend.en: Conditional authority, specialist, or external observation
connector_legend.zh_cn: 有条件的授权、specialist 或外部观察

connector_legend.en: New evidence reopens diagnosis or the next increment
connector_legend.zh_cn: 新证据重新打开诊断或下一 increment

purpose.en: Bind one owner intent and requested terminal boundary to one exact repository identity.
purpose.zh_cn: 把一个所有者意图及请求终点绑定到一个精确仓库身份。

purpose.en: Find what owns truth now and which selectors actually reach it.
purpose.zh_cn: 找到当前真正拥有事实的表面，以及实际到达它的 selectors。

purpose.en: Keep source, derived artifacts, installed identity, and proof gates distinct.
purpose.zh_cn: 区分 source、derived artifacts、installed identity 与 proof gates。

purpose.en: Close every material trace and distinguish defects, multiplicity, residue, and unknowns.
purpose.zh_cn: 闭合每条实质 trace，并区分缺陷、多重模式、残留与未知。

purpose.en: Reach a truth fixed point, then close Audit or Plan without target mutation.
purpose.zh_cn: 抵达事实固定点，再在不改变目标的情况下闭合 Audit 或 Plan。

purpose.en: Cross a real implementation gate, preserve protected witnesses, and distinguish verified checkpoints from whole-goal completion.
purpose.zh_cn: 跨过真实实施 gate，保留受保护 witnesses，并区分 verified checkpoint 与完整目标完成。

purpose.en: Keep runtime, edge, device, account, and owner acceptance unclaimed until freshly and permissibly observed.
purpose.zh_cn: 在得到新鲜且获准的观察前，不声称 runtime、edge、device、account 或 owner acceptance。

label.zh_cn: 所有者意图与终点边界

responsibility.en: Name one decision or finite change outcome and whether the requested terminal is Audit, Plan, or Operate.
responsibility.zh_cn: 明确一个决策或有限变更结果，并识别请求终点是 Audit、Plan 还是 Operate。

limit.en: Mode selects the outcome, not powers; ambiguous cleanup remains read-only reconnaissance.
limit.zh_cn: Mode 选择结果而不创造权力；含糊 cleanup 只能进入只读 reconnaissance。

responsibility.en: Capture physical root, Git root, branch/HEAD, working tree, upstream, worktree, and submodule identity.
responsibility.zh_cn: 记录 physical root、Git root、branch/HEAD、working tree、upstream、worktree 与 submodule identity。

limit.en: A clean sibling checkout proves nothing about the selected target.
limit.zh_cn: 相邻 checkout 的 clean 状态不能证明所选目标。

responsibility.en: Audit and Plan stay read-only; Operate also reconstructs current truth before its separate implementation gate.
responsibility.zh_cn: Audit 与 Plan 保持只读；Operate 也先重建当前事实，再到独立实施 gate。

limit.en: A mode, plan, report, worker, or record cannot grant mutation authority.
limit.zh_cn: Mode、plan、report、worker 或 record 都不能创造修改权限。

label.zh_cn: 当前权威与已接受意图

responsibility.en: Resolve source/state ownership and adopted product intent from scoped specs, decisions or supplied conversations; retain constraints and supersession.
responsibility.zh_cn: 解析 source/state 归属，从限定的规格、决策或指定对话还原已接受产品意图，保留约束与替代关系。

limit.en: Historical evidence and polished docs do not silently become current authority.
limit.zh_cn: 历史证据与精美文档不会自动成为当前权威。

responsibility.en: Trace registrations, metadata, manifests, imports, callers, build pipelines, service/config owners, persistence, install receipts, and operator routes.
responsibility.zh_cn: 追踪 registrations、metadata、manifests、imports、callers、build pipelines、service/config owners、persistence、install receipts 与 operator routes。

limit.en: File presence is not reachability; labels and defaults are not selection proof.
limit.zh_cn: 文件存在不等于可达；标签与 defaults 也不是选择证明。

responsibility.en: Resolve selector, owner/purpose, callers, state isolation, version/artifact identity, and compatibility or retirement intent.
responsibility.zh_cn: 解析 selector、owner/purpose、callers、state isolation、version/artifact identity，以及 compatibility 或 retirement intent。

limit.en: Multiple paths are not drift until selection or isolation fails.
limit.zh_cn: 多条路径并不天然构成 drift；关键是选择与隔离是否失效。

responsibility.en: Identify the layer that owns behavior or persistent truth for the decision.
responsibility.zh_cn: 识别为该决策拥有行为或持久事实的层。

limit.en: Canonical source does not prove a built, installed, deployed, or accepted instance.
limit.zh_cn: Canonical source 不证明 built、installed、deployed 或 accepted instance。

responsibility.en: Map derivation identity and the source-to-artifact relation that the decision depends on.
responsibility.zh_cn: 映射决策所依赖的 derivation identity 与 source-to-artifact relation。

limit.en: A green build proves the artifact it produced, not installation or runtime behavior.
limit.zh_cn: Green build 只证明其产物，不证明 installation 或 runtime behavior。

responsibility.en: Record an exact installed or deployed instance only when it is freshly observed within scope.
responsibility.zh_cn: 只有在范围内得到新鲜观察时，才记录精确的 installed 或 deployed instance。

limit.en: Source, package, receipt, and running instance remain separate identities.
limit.zh_cn: Source、package、receipt 与 running instance 始终是不同身份。

responsibility.en: For docs, tests, status, and receipts, name the exact input, assertion, proof layer, and observed identity.
responsibility.zh_cn: 对 docs、tests、status 与 receipts，说明 exact input、assertion、proof layer 与 observed identity。

limit.en: Passing evidence never upgrades a claim to the next layer automatically.
limit.zh_cn: 证据通过不会自动把 claim 升级到下一层。

responsibility.en: Trace accepted intent to selected behavior and evidence; trace existing responsibilities to purpose. Close gap, user consequence, counterevidence and acceptance.
responsibility.zh_cn: 从已接受意图追踪所选行为及证据，也从现有责任反查用途；闭合差距、用户影响、反证与验收。

limit.en: A stale file, duplicate path, or missing observation alone is not a finding.
limit.zh_cn: 旧文件、重复路径或缺失观察本身都不是 finding。

responsibility.en: Ask whether the exact path ran, the assertion was observable, a broken invariant would fail, and the claimed layer was actually proved.
responsibility.zh_cn: 追问 exact path 是否运行、assertion 是否可观察、破坏 invariant 是否会失败，以及 claimed layer 是否真的被证明。

limit.en: Use a disposable mutation challenge only when safe; never mutate the real target by default.
limit.zh_cn: 只在安全时使用 disposable mutation challenge；默认绝不改动真实目标。

label.zh_cn: Intentional multiplicity 还是 shadow path？

responsibility.en: Adjudicate using selector, ownership, isolated state, version identity, callers, and compatibility or retirement intent.
responsibility.zh_cn: 依据 selector、ownership、isolated state、version identity、callers 与 compatibility/retirement intent 裁定。

limit.en: Intentional, selected, isolated modes remain clean; reachable ambiguity can become a shadow path.
limit.zh_cn: 有意、可选择且隔离的模式保持 clean；可达歧义才可能成为 shadow path。

responsibility.en: State: missing observation → prevented claim → affected decision → exact fresh observation needed.
responsibility.zh_cn: 说明：missing observation → prevented claim → affected decision → 所需的 exact fresh observation。

limit.en: Unavailable runtime or account state is not automatically a repository defect.
limit.zh_cn: 不可得的 runtime 或 account state 不会自动成为仓库缺陷。

responsibility.en: Bring in a protocol, deployment, browser, storage, or domain specialist only for a material observation.
responsibility.zh_cn: 仅为实质观察引入 protocol、deployment、browser、storage 或 domain specialist。

limit.en: No default fan-out; if its answer cannot change the decision, do not invoke it.
limit.zh_cn: 不做默认 fan-out；若答案不能改变决策，就不调用。

responsibility.en: Record validated contradiction, false-green evidence, shadow path, intentional multiplicity, non-material residue, decision-critical unknown, external boundary, or clean within scope. For intent comparison, distinguish missing/partial journeys, drift, stale promises and accumulation from accepted evolution and explicit deferral.
responsibility.zh_cn: 记录 validated contradiction、false-green evidence、shadow path、intentional multiplicity、non-material residue、decision-critical unknown、external boundary 或 clean within scope。 意图对照还区分缺失/局部流程、偏移、陈旧承诺与堆积，以及合理演进和明确延期。

limit.en: Do not collapse distinct outcomes into a score, maturity grade, or generic issue list.
limit.zh_cn: 不要把不同结果压成 score、maturity grade 或 generic issue list。

responsibility.en: Every candidate is adjudicated; no new decision-relevant evidence edge remains; other surfaces cannot change the answer; external limits are explicit.
responsibility.zh_cn: 每个候选项均已裁定；不再出现新的决策相关证据边；其余表面不能改变答案；外部限制已明确。

limit.en: If a new material edge appears, traverse again; do not stop by checklist exhaustion.
limit.zh_cn: 若出现新的实质证据边，就重新穿行；不能靠 checklist 耗尽来停止。

responsibility.en: Report the answer, pinned identity, live topology, full finding/unknown traces, intentional non-findings, verification, and overhead receipt.
responsibility.zh_cn: 报告答案、pinned identity、live topology、完整 findings/unknown traces、intentional non-findings、verification 与 overhead receipt。

limit.en: No default AUDIT.md, durable backlog, repair loop, or claim beyond the observed layer.
limit.zh_cn: 不默认生成 AUDIT.md、durable backlog、repair loop，也不声称超出已观察层。

responsibility.en: Reconcile the ending repository identity with the start pin and state the mode, mutations, terminal status, and proof layer.
responsibility.zh_cn: 把结束时的仓库身份与起始钉点核对，并说明 mode、mutations、terminal status 与 proof layer。

limit.en: An unexplained moving target invalidates the claimed snapshot-bound answer.
limit.zh_cn: 未经解释的移动目标会使 snapshot-bound answer 失效。

responsibility.en: State the finite end state, effect envelope, dependency order, witnesses, recovery boundary, acceptance obligations, and unresolved decisions.
responsibility.zh_cn: 说明有限 end state、effect envelope、依赖顺序、witnesses、recovery boundary、acceptance obligations 与未决决策。

limit.en: A plan is a complete read-only result; it carries no latent implementation authority.
limit.zh_cn: Plan 是完整只读结果，不携带潜在实施权限。

responsibility.en: Bind concrete change pressure to a testable end state, preserved behavior, agreed changes, and applicable B/S/D/U obligations.
responsibility.zh_cn: 把具体 change pressure 绑定到可测试 end state、保留行为、约定变化与适用的 B/S/D/U obligations。

limit.en: File length, old names, or an unbounded cleanup wish do not define an operation.
limit.zh_cn: 文件长度、旧名字或无界 cleanup 愿望都不能定义一场 operation。

responsibility.en: Require explicit action intent, an identifiable target, a finite outcome, and a real effect envelope before target mutation.
responsibility.zh_cn: 在修改目标前，要求显式 action intent、可识别 target、有限 outcome 与真实 effect envelope。

limit.en: Mode, plans, reports, workers, receipts, and records cannot grant powers; new effects require matching authority.
limit.zh_cn: Mode、plan、report、worker、receipt 与 record 不能创造权力；新增效果需要匹配授权。

label.zh_cn: 受保护的 behavior + structure witnesses

responsibility.en: Observe the selected entry, failures, compatibility and state effects; add a separate falsifiable structural-completion check. When closing a product gap, acceptance follows the adopted user journey at the selected entry.
responsibility.zh_cn: 观察 selected entry、failures、compatibility 与 state effects，并增加独立、可判错的 structural-completion check。 补齐产品差距时，从实际所选入口验收已接受的用户流程。

limit.en: The candidate cannot erase, skip, relearn, or weaken its own decisive witness merely to pass.
limit.zh_cn: Candidate 不能为了通过而删除、skip、重学或弱化自己的关键 witness。

responsibility.en: Reconcile current inputs, implement one convergent semantic change, inspect the real diff and preserve unrelated owner work.
responsibility.zh_cn: 核对当前 inputs，实现一个收敛的 semantic change，检查真实 diff 并保留无关 owner work。

limit.en: A first safe cut is progress, not permission to shrink the whole agreed goal.
limit.zh_cn: 第一刀安全完成只是进展，不是缩小完整约定目标的许可。

responsibility.en: Run current behavioral, structural, and delivery checks; attempt the strongest plausible falsifier and label self-check versus independent review honestly.
responsibility.zh_cn: 运行当前 behavior、structure 与 delivery checks；尝试最强可信 falsifier，并诚实标记 self-check 或 independent review。

limit.en: Worker completion, CI, byte matches, and reviewer confidence are evidence inputs, not automatic acceptance.
limit.zh_cn: Worker completion、CI、byte match 与 reviewer confidence 都只是 evidence input，不会自动构成验收。

responsibility.en: Retain one coherent increment with current proof while keeping the original goal and remaining obligations explicit.
responsibility.zh_cn: 保留一个拥有当前证明的 coherent increment，同时明确原目标与剩余 obligations。

limit.en: Checkpoint is not Complete while required callers, owners, selectors, artifacts, or retirement work remain.
limit.zh_cn: 当必要 caller、owner、selector、artifact 或 retirement work 仍存在时，Checkpoint 不是 Complete。

responsibility.en: Classify effects as absent, complete, partial, concurrently changed, or unobservable before another write or replay.
responsibility.zh_cn: 再次写入或 replay 前，把 effects 分类为 absent、complete、partial、concurrently changed 或 unobservable。

limit.en: A record is neither permission nor freshness proof; uncertain data, install, remote, or public effects are not replayed blindly.
limit.zh_cn: Record 既不是权限也不是 freshness proof；不盲目 replay 不确定的 data、install、remote 或 public effect。

label.zh_cn: 完整目标 B/S/D/U 验收

responsibility.en: Require current evidence for every applicable Behavior, Structure, Delivery, and Usefulness obligation at the requested proof layer. When closing a product gap, acceptance follows the adopted user journey at the selected entry.
responsibility.zh_cn: 在请求 proof layer 为每个适用的 Behavior、Structure、Delivery 与 Usefulness obligation 要求当前证据。 补齐产品差距时，从实际所选入口验收已接受的用户流程。

limit.en: Missing delivery evidence blocks only an included delivery goal; source completion never masquerades as deployment or owner acceptance.
limit.zh_cn: 缺少 delivery evidence 只阻塞已纳入的 delivery goal；source completion 不冒充 deployment 或 owner acceptance。

responsibility.en: Report the actual terminal state, changes and effects, decisive current evidence, proof layer, remaining unknowns, and final workspace identity.
responsibility.zh_cn: 报告真实 terminal state、changes/effects、关键当前证据、proof layer、剩余 unknown 与最终 workspace identity。

limit.en: Owner acceptance is claimed only when separately observed; incomplete scope is never renamed success.
limit.zh_cn: 只有单独观察后才声称 owner acceptance；未完成范围绝不改名为 success。

responsibility.en: Cross only with explicit scope and authorization, using an exact current observation that can change the decision.
responsibility.zh_cn: 只有在范围与授权明确时才跨越，并使用能够改变决策的精确当前观察。

limit.en: A source audit never silently authorizes browser, account, remote, deployment, or owner actions.
limit.zh_cn: Source audit 绝不会默许 browser、account、remote、deployment 或 owner action。

label.en: Runtime · edge · device · account · owner acceptance
label.zh_cn: Runtime · edge · device · account · owner acceptance

responsibility.en: Provide a fresh named-instance observation only when the gate is crossed legitimately.
responsibility.zh_cn: 仅在合法跨越 gate 后，提供对具名 instance 的新鲜观察。

limit.en: Until observed, this region remains an explicit unknown — never inferred from repository evidence.
limit.zh_cn: 在被观察前，该区域保持显式未知，绝不从仓库证据推断。

states.invariant: Do not begin exhaustive traversal or mutation without a concrete decision or finite outcome.
The selected repository identity is explicit and no implementation gate has been crossed.
Every explored surface remains connected to the owner decision.
Every material candidate has a full trace or an explicit proof boundary.
No remaining repository-observable edge can change the bounded answer.
The mode, terminal status, result, unknowns, mutations, proof boundary, and ending identity are explicit.
Explicit action intent, target, finite outcome, and effect authority are current.
One writer owns each shared state boundary and the whole agreed goal remains explicit.
Every applicable Behavior, Structure, Delivery, and Usefulness obligation has current evidence at the requested layer.

source_authorities.role: Accepted Audit / Plan / Operate behavior, authority, and output contract
Proof layers, findings, checkpoints, completion obligations, recovery, and stopping semantics
Runtime router, authority boundary, and shared engagement workflow
Repository ownership, mode/effect authority, publication, and source/install boundaries

render_acceptance: The Audit / Plan / Operate topology is embedded directly in each localized README as a native Mermaid block.
All seven regions and all stable node IDs are present in both locale diagrams.
Source, derived artifact, installed identity, and external state remain visually distinct.
The read-only diagnosis boundary, explicit implementation gate, and external proof boundary are visible without reading body prose.
The feedback loops from the audit stopping test, verified checkpoint, and recovery reconciliation are visible.
The diagram remains readable in GitHub's normal README rendering without fixed-canvas microtext.
The English and Simplified Chinese diagrams preserve semantic parity without sharing one bilingual canvas.
The Mermaid source contains no custom theme colors, scripts, network dependencies, or embedded image content.
